# The seats

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_seats_md.py from the catalogue, the rulebooks and the planner. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every seat in the catalogue (29), then the eight merged seats a small team can run as one session,
then the four new roles setup creates when no catalogue seat covers the work. Each row's job is the
opening of that seat's rulebook description (the part before *Use when*); kinds, reporting lines and
*seat it when* come from the catalogue (`skills/team-setup/references/seats.md`). Setup scans the
repo and proposes seats with the evidence for each ([how the team is
sized](how-it-works.md#how-the-team-is-sized)). Add one by name later (*"add Motion to the team"*),
or let a re-evaluation propose it.

**Kinds.** *Owner-side* seats speak for or to you. *Directors* own a register and rule inside it.
The *manager* runs a daily operation under directors. *Implementation* seats build under a
director's scope. *Checks* challenge other seats' work and own no product register.

**Coordination seats.** *Other seats* means every seat except 🛎️ Chief of Staff and ✂️ Scope
Trimmer; a merged, split or new seat counts as one. The Chief of Staff joins once five or more other
seats run (seven in the lean option), and the Scope Trimmer once ten or more do, in setup's options
and in a re-evaluation alike.

## Merged seats

One session holding several roles. Its rulebook is composed from its members' rulebooks: each
member's opening and every section of each, kept under "As <member>", and recomposed when they
improve (*"sync the team's rulebooks"*). Its brief carries its members' briefs.

|  | Seat | Open with | Holds | Kind | Why one session can hold it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 📈 | **Growth** | `/seat-growth` | 💼 Sales & Marketing + 📣 SEO & Publicity + 💬 Social Media Manager | director | one seat owns words, reach and the channels while the audience is small |
| 🎨 | **Product & Design** | `/seat-product-design` | 🎯 Product + 📐 Design | director | one seat decides what to build and how it looks while the surface is small |
| 🔧 | **Engineering & Platform** | `/seat-engineering-platform` | ⚙️ Engineering + 🛰️ Platform | director | one seat builds and ships while there is one deploy target |
| 🛡️ | **Quality** | `/seat-quality` | 🧪 Testing + ⚖️ Bar Raiser | check | one independent check owns the test standard and re-measures finished work |
| 💰 | **Money** | `/seat-money` | 🏦 Funding, Revenue & Investment + 💳 Payments & Company Legal | director | one seat tracks where money comes from and how it is received |
| 📜 | **Legal & Compliance** | `/seat-legal-compliance` | 💳 Payments & Company Legal + 🗂️ Compliance & Audit | director | one seat holds the legal pages, licences and personal data |
| 🧮 | **Data & ML** | `/seat-data-ml` | 🗄️ Data engineer + 🧠 ML engineer | director | one seat owns the pipelines and the models built on them while both are young |
| 🫱 | **Customer** | `/seat-customer` | 🤝 Customer Success + 🌱 Community & DevRel | director | one seat champions users and contributors while there are few of either |

**Which option merges what.** A merge needs two or more of its members in the team, and claims them:
two merges never share a member. *Lean* takes every merge that fits. *Recommended* takes every merge
for a tiny project; for a small one only 📈 Growth, 📜 Legal & Compliance, 🫱 Customer and 🧮 Data & ML;
none for a medium or large one. *Full* takes none.

**💰 Money never forms at setup unless you edit the plan.** It needs 🏦 Funding, Revenue & Investment,
which only the full option seats, and the full option merges nothing; so at setup 💳 Payments &
Company Legal goes to 📜 Legal & Compliance. A re-evaluation can propose 💰 Money later, when both its
members are seated and quiet.

**🔧 Engineering & Platform is never formed past 2,000 source files**, at setup or at a
re-evaluation. **A check seat (⚖️ Bar Raiser, ✂️ Scope Trimmer, 👤 User, 🔐 Security) joins only a
check merge**: 🛡️ Quality, which setup forms when it merges. No merge a re-evaluation proposes holds
🧭 CEO or ⚖️ Bar Raiser.

## New roles

Roles no catalogue seat covers, raised by what the scan finds. Each is derived from the base
rulebook named here and arrives with an `AUTHORING NEEDED` banner: the session that seats it
rewrites it for the role (`skills/team-setup/references/seat-contract.md`) before the seat works.
Until then the seat has no worker and `scripts/gen-team-agents.py --check` fails; after the rewrite,
run `python3 scripts/gen-team-agents.py`, then `--check`.

|  | Seat | Open with | Derived from | Kind | Reports to | Scope | Raised by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🔌 | **Hardware & firmware engineer** | `/seat-hardware` | `seat-mobile` | implementation | Engineering | firmware and board design: a shipped device can't be patched like a web page | files `platformio.ini`, `*.ino`, `*.kicad_pcb`, `*.kicad_sch`, `sdkconfig`, `*.dts`, `Kconfig` |
| ⛓️ | **Smart-contract engineer** | `/seat-contracts` | `seat-security` | implementation | Engineering | on-chain code: every deployment is a one-way door, audits before mainnet | files `*.sol`, `hardhat.config.*`, `foundry.toml`, `Anchor.toml`; dependencies such as `hardhat`, `ethers`, `viem` |
| 🖱️ | **Desktop engineer** | `/seat-desktop` | `seat-mobile` | implementation | Engineering | the desktop app: signed installers and auto-update are one-way doors | dependencies such as `electron`, `@tauri-apps/`, `tauri` |
| 🧷 | **Browser-extension engineer** | `/seat-extension` | `seat-frontend` | implementation | Engineering | the browser extension: permissions and store review decide what ships | files `manifest.json` containing `manifest_version` |

**Splits.** A project with two or more web UI apps can run one frontend seat per app (`Frontend
engineer (<app>)`, marks 💻 🪟 📟 🧩, up to four), each derived from `seat-frontend` with its scope set
to its own folder. Past four apps, 🖥️ Frontend engineer stays and holds the rest. *Full* offers the
split whenever there are two or more UI apps; *recommended* only once the project is large.

## Starter shapes

What setup offers on the invented test projects in `tests/repo_fixtures.py`, measured by running
`scan.py` and `plan.py` on them each time this page is regenerated. Your repo's own evidence decides
your team.

| Project | Size | Lean | Recommended | Full |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| a small open-source library | tiny | 5 | 6 | 7 |
| a web product that takes sign-ups and payments | tiny | 10 | 12 | 21 |
| the same web product | small | 10 | 16 | 21 |
| the same web product | medium | 10 | 19 | 21 (22 when it serves an API) |
| a monorepo: two web apps, a mobile app, models, a warehouse, locales, firmware | small | 10 | 15 | 19 |

- **The library** (tests, CI, a licence and a contributing guide): recommended is 🧭 CEO, 🛎️ Chief of
  Staff, ⚙️ Engineering, 📚 Docs writer, 🌱 Community & DevRel, 🛡️ Quality.
- **The web product** (payments, sign-in, email, product analytics, a pricing page, a blog, customer
  emails in its schema, deploy files): lean holds 16 roles in 10 sessions. Recommended while tiny is
  🧭 CEO, 🛎️ Chief of Staff, 🖥️ Frontend engineer, ✂️ Scope Trimmer, 🤝 Customer Success, 👤 User,
  🔐 Security, 📈 Growth, 🎨 Product & Design, 🔧 Engineering & Platform, 🛡️ Quality, 📜 Legal &
  Compliance. Past tiny, 🔬 Research joins (product analytics are in) and the merges thin out; at
  medium every role has its own seat. Full adds ♟️ Competition & Market and 🏦 Funding, Revenue &
  Investment, and 📚 Docs writer when it serves an API.
- **The monorepo**: 🔌 Hardware & firmware engineer joins as a new role in every option, and full
  splits the frontend per app: 💻 Frontend engineer (admin), 🪟 Frontend engineer (web).
